name: Kalari Rasayana (CGH Earth)
summary: Kalari Rasayana is a CGH Earth Ayurveda centre and hospital in an eight-acre coconut grove on the Paravur backwaters. It is NABH accredited and combines Ayurvedic treatment with yoga and meditation.
highlights: Eight acres of coconut grove on the Paravur backwaters
22 rooms and a clinic with 11 treatment rooms
Ayurveda with yoga, meditation and cultural evenings
Meals prepared under the direction of its Ayurveda physicians
